pattern.description: The next AI-agent chat message (avatar plus a three-line reply bubble) appears below the customer's 'Thank you', fading in while drifting up a short distance and decelerating into place.
pattern.why_premium: The same soft fade-and-rise grammar is reused for every message, so the conversation feels consistent and live; the long decelerating tail avoids a mechanical pop.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.msg-agent-4', {autoAlpha: 0, y: 24}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'expo.out'}); avatar and bubble share the tween (text is whole, not per line).
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); style={{opacity: p, transform: `translateY(${interpolate(p, [0, 1], [24, 0])}px)`}} on the avatar+bubble row.

notes: Repeat of the e008 message-append grammar. Text lines (b03, b04, b05) move with the bubble and are not listed separately. Filmstrip is a crop around the new row; a slight grow during the rise is possible (camera.move none).
